newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal non-tradable goods prices up 4.2 pct Apr.
newsitem.headline: Portugal non-tradable goods prices up 4.2 pct Apr.

text.p: The index of Portuguese non-tradable goods prices rose 4.2 percent in April, compared with 4.5 percent in March, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.
INE also said in a statement that the year-on-year variation of consumer prices should fall in the coming months.
"The year-on-year variation of consumer prices should continue to fall in the coming months, taking into consideration the strong rise in prices of some foodstuffs in 1996," it said.
